Usage: ocfl stage commit [flags]

Commit the stage as a new object version

Flags:
  -h, --help                      Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING               The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root
                                  used for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                     enable debug log messages

  -f, --file="ocfl-stage.json"    path to stage file

  -m, --message=STRING            Message to include in the object version
                                  metadata
  -n, --name=STRING               Username to include in the object version
                                  metadata ($OCFL_USER_NAME)
  -e, --email=STRING              User email to include in the object version
                                  metadata ($OCFL_USER_EMAIL)
